topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: Well, I never thought such a thing would happen to me. I just went down to the village square where they've put up a board for folks to read and learn from. There, my words, my very thoughts, were pinned for all to see. It's the essay I wrote for that place far away, where young minds go to learn more. I didn't know they'd choose mine as an example, something to hold up for others. I’m just a simple soul, not used to such attention. Now, all the neighbors might start asking questions. I hope I don’t disappoint them. I only hoped to do well, to bring honor to our village, not to stand out like a tree stripped of its leaves.
